summary: The ep-8 regression is a FALSE positive: ep 8 (2015-08-28) is correct and the typo is on ep 7. The 12 TV episodes aired weekly with no skips from 2015-07-11 to 2015-09-26 (published Saturday 01:05 dates); our stored per-episode dates are one day earlier (the Friday 25:05 slot), e.g. stored ep 6 = 2015-08-14 vs published 2015-08-15. The repair keeps that stored convention.

repairs.why: Ep 7 "Meiko's Delicious Restaurant" (メイコトゥイユ / 'Meikotouille') aired 2015-08-21 24:05 (published 2015-08-22). Stored 2015-12-21 is a month-digit slip (12 for 08) - the series had ended by December 2015 - and it is what produced the ep-8 regression; ep 8 (2015-08-28, published 08-29) is correct.

structure.notes: 12 TV rows, weekly, no skips. The 2016-03-04 'Mad Wax' OVA is our stored series end date but is not one of the 12 flagged rows.

flags_for_sean: prison-school: our stored series START (2015-07-11) uses the published Saturday date while the per-episode rows use the Friday one - a one-day convention mismatch between the series header and the episode rows, worth a sweep beyond this series.
